item.title: Observer
item.description: Observer cuts coupling through a one-to-many relationship that notifies subscribers of state changes. The Subject just notifies, unaware of who listens. EventEmitter, RxJS, and event-driven architecture all extend from here. It differs from broker-mediated pub/sub.
